title: runs/ledger/<run>.json: one video in the channel's ledger (tools/deliver.py writes it, the owner commits it)

run.description: the run folder's name, as in the file name

status.description: delivered: handed over for the owner's own upload; the others as in the Pages ledger

delivered_at.description: UTC time of the hand-over (ISO 8601; the date alone when only the day is known)

primary_urls.description: the topic's subject primary sources (sources.json); none for a series episode
